دُمَاعٌ Water of the eye arising from disease or old age; not tears: (S:) or, as some say, the traces of tears upon the face: thus in the handwriting of Aboo-Zekereeyà, in the margin of a copy of the S. (TA.) ―
-b2- دُمَاعُ الكَرْمِ, (S, A,) or ↓ الدُّمَّاعُ , like رُمَّان, (K,) and thus written by Sgh, with teshdeed, (TA,) (tropical:) What flows from the grape-vine in the days of the [season called] رَبِيع (S, A, K, * TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
